name: Peach and Pork Skewers
ingredients: 1+ peach (more depending on how much you like peach)
1 pork tenderloin + brining equipment (salt, water, bag)
equipment: Grill (alternately, a pan + wire rack with the oven if you're trying to broil these)
method: Brine the tenderloin for at least an hour.
About half an hour before you're ready to cook, soak the bamboo skewers in a bowl of water. This makes sure they don't light on fire later during cooking.
Chop the tenderloin into long strips. Chop the peach into thick slices.
Coat the pork strips in your spice of choice and then thread each strip around a slice of peach. Apply to skewer.
Add red onion and pepper to skewer alternately. Repeat step 3 until you have 2-3 chunks of pork on each skewer. If you have bacon, thread that in the same way but on the opposite side.
Continue making as many skewers as you feel like you can eat / have ingredients for.
Fire up the grill to half-heat, or broil on medium or low.
Cook skewers for roughly 8-10 minutes a side, depending on grill or oven power. Serve immediately.
notes: This is a time consuming process to set up the damn skewers, but the result is worth it.
